purpose: This medication is used to treat chronic Hepatitis C virus infection in adults and some children. It is a powerful combination medicine that can actually cure Hepatitis C in most patients. Your doctor will determine how long you need to take it based on your specific situation.
how_it_works: Hepatitis C is a virus that lives and multiplies in your liver. This medicine contains two ingredients that work together to block the tools the virus needs to copy itself. Without being able to reproduce, the virus levels drop dramatically and eventually become undetectable, which means the infection is cured.
common_side_effects: The most common side effects are tiredness or fatigue, headache, feeling weak, nausea, diarrhea, and trouble sleeping. Most people tolerate this medication very well and side effects are usually mild.
warnings: Tell your doctor if you are taking the heart rhythm drug amiodarone, as this combination can cause a serious slow heartbeat. Also let your doctor know if you have or had Hepatitis B infection, as it can become active again during treatment. Do not take antacids containing aluminum or magnesium within 4 hours of your dose. Tell your doctor about ALL other medications, vitamins, and supplements you take, as many drugs can interact with this medicine.
typical_dosing: The usual dose is one tablet taken by mouth once a day, with or without food. It is very important to take it at the same time every day and not to miss any doses. Treatment usually lasts 8 to 24 weeks depending on your condition.
